problem_description: An incident has been detected in the Online Boutique cluster. Investigate using available tools and identify the root cause and appropriate remediation action.

acceptable_root_causes: native memory stress job causing resource pressure

problem.scenario: an AgentScope native memory stress job creates cluster pressure affecting frontend traffic

telemetry_contract.notes: Requires stress-job metadata plus memory/resource evidence.

problem.notes: Medium native cluster-pressure task; stress-job detector metadata must remain available in raw artifacts.

output.distinguishing_question: Are the timeout errors to adservice and application validation errors on /cart requests related to the same root cause, or are these separate issues? Dependency traces would show if adservice timeouts correlate with the cart validation failures.

output.why_this_class: The evidence shows external resource pressure from a non-application workload (agentscope-collection-worker) causing memory pressure at the node/namespace level. While frontend shows elevated latency (p99=488ms) and application errors, its app-local resource utilization is low (CPU 40%, memory 26%, minimal throttling). The cluster resource context confirms active external workload causing memory pressure, which aligns with the symptoms of degraded performance without app-local saturation.
output.why_not_nearest_alternative: native_dependency_bad_endpoint was considered due to timeout errors to adservice, but the single timeout error (vs 6 application errors) and the presence of confirmed external memory pressure better explains the latency and error patterns. The application validation errors on /cart requests are likely secondary effects of the memory pressure rather than dependency configuration issues.

solution.root_cause: External memory pressure from non-application workload (agentscope-collection-worker) is causing performance degradation in frontend service, resulting in elevated latency and application errors despite low app-local resource utilization.
solution.action_taken: Delete the external stress workload agentscope-collection-worker to eliminate memory pressure and restore normal performance
